name: aaimeraud-skills
description: Agent skills organised by topic and use case, installable as Claude Code plugins. One plugin per use case.

plugins.name: homework
plugins.description: Homework helper: reviews exercises, checks answers and gives hints without giving away the answers.

plugins.name: mentor
plugins.description: Mentor for personal coding projects: unblocks, reviews and explains concepts in the context of the current task, optionally read from Linear, without writing the task's code.

plugins.name: linear
plugins.description: Turns a planning discussion into a Linear project with milestones, documents and issues in a neutral, team-readable tone.
